unprecedented.en: The research team reported unprecedented growth in renewable energy adoption last year.
unprecedented.zh: 研究团队报告称，去年可再生能源的采用率出现了前所未有的增长。

unprecedented.en: Such an ambitious deadline would be unprecedented in the history of the industry.
unprecedented.zh: 如此雄心勃勃的截止期限在该行业历史上将是前所未有的。

unprecedented.en: The collaboration produced unprecedented results that surprised every reviewer.
unprecedented.zh: 这次合作取得了令人惊讶的空前成果，让每一位评审都感到意外。

exceptionally.en: The southern coast is exceptionally rich in minerals and rare plants.
exceptionally.zh: 南海岸的矿产和珍稀植物资源格外丰富。

exceptionally.en: Enrollment grew exceptionally fast after the new policy took effect.
exceptionally.zh: 新政策生效后，入学人数增长得非常迅速。

exceptionally.en: Visitors should wear jackets, since evenings can be exceptionally cold.
exceptionally.zh: 游客应携带外套，因为夜间可能会格外寒冷。

hitherto.en: The hitherto ignored documents now provide valuable evidence for historians.
hitherto.zh: 这些迄今一直无人问津的文件如今为历史学家提供了宝贵证据。

hitherto.en: Hitherto private archives have been opened to qualified researchers.
hitherto.zh: 迄今为止一直处于私人保管的档案已向合格研究者开放。

hitherto.en: Her hitherto unproven method yielded remarkably consistent results.
hitherto.zh: 她那套迄今未经验证的方法却取得了出奇一致的结果。

controversial.en: The proposal to raise tuition fees proved highly controversial among students.
controversial.zh: 提高学费的提案在学生中引发了极大争议。

controversial.en: The controversial decision was later reviewed by an independent panel.
controversial.zh: 这一有争议的决定后来由一个独立小组进行了复核。

controversial.en: Researchers remain divided over the controversial findings published last spring.
controversial.zh: 研究人员对去年春天发表的有争议的结论仍存分歧。

peculiar.en: The specimens displayed a peculiar metallic sheen that resisted explanation.
peculiar.zh: 这些样本呈现出一种奇特的金属光泽，无法解释。

peculiar.en: Every city has peculiar customs that outsiders rarely notice.
peculiar.zh: 每座城市都有外人很少注意到的独特习俗。

peculiar.en: His peculiar manner of speaking unsettled everyone in the room.
peculiar.zh: 他说话方式古怪，房间里的所有人都感到不安。

yield.en: The new battery technology yields far more energy than conventional cells.
yield.zh: 这种新型电池技术产生的能量远超传统电池。

yield.en: Repeated trials of the algorithm yielded surprisingly consistent results.
yield.zh: 对该算法的反复试验得出了出乎意料地一致的结果。

yield.en: The committee refused to yield to pressure for a faster timetable.
yield.zh: 委员会拒绝屈服于要求加快进度的压力。

unexpectedly.en: The device unexpectedly stopped working during the final demonstration.
unexpectedly.zh: 该装置在最后演示过程中意外地停止运行。

unexpectedly.en: Sales unexpectedly declined despite the substantial advertising campaign.
unexpectedly.zh: 尽管投入了大量广告宣传，销量还是出乎意料地下降了。

unexpectedly.en: The two departments unexpectedly reached a compromise on the new budget.
unexpectedly.zh: 两个部门出人意料地就新预算达成了妥协。

stem from.en: Many of these errors stem from a lack of clarity in the original design.
stem from.zh: 其中许多错误源于原始设计缺乏明确性。

stem from.en: Her interest in linguistics stems from childhood exposure to multiple languages.
stem from.zh: 她对语言学的兴趣源于童年时期接触多种语言。

stem from.en: The growing demand for housing stems from rapid population growth in the region.
stem from.zh: 不断增长的住房需求源自该地区人口的快速增长。

puzzling.en: The puzzling results of the experiment have prompted several follow-up studies.
puzzling.zh: 实验结果令人费解，促使研究者开展了数项后续研究。

puzzling.en: Several puzzling similarities between the two manuscripts remain unexplained.
puzzling.zh: 两份手稿之间若干令人费解的相似之处仍无解释。

puzzling.en: Her puzzling silence during the meeting worried the entire research team.
puzzling.zh: 她在会议上的沉默令人费解，这让整个研究团队都很担心。

contrast.en: There is a sharp contrast between the two theoretical frameworks.
contrast.zh: 这两个理论框架之间形成了鲜明的对比。

contrast.en: In contrast, the second experiment produced entirely consistent readings.
contrast.zh: 相比之下，第二次实验产生了完全一致的读数。

contrast.en: The report draws a clear contrast between urban and rural living standards.
contrast.zh: 该报告清楚地对城市与农村的生活水平作了对比。

extensive.en: Extensive fieldwork over three years reshaped the original hypothesis.
extensive.zh: 三年广泛的田野调查重塑了最初的假设。

extensive.en: The library holds extensive records of every local land transaction.
extensive.zh: 图书馆保存着每一笔本地土地交易的大量记录。

extensive.en: The damage to the coastal ecosystem was far more extensive than reported.
extensive.zh: 对沿海生态系统的损害范围远比报告中所述更大。

complementary.en: The two theories are complementary rather than competing explanations of the data.
complementary.zh: 这两个理论是互补的，而非对数据的竞争性解释。

complementary.en: Qualitative interviews provided complementary evidence to the statistical analysis.
complementary.zh: 定性访谈为统计分析提供了补充性的证据。

complementary.en: The teaching role and the research role have always been complementary here.
complementary.zh: 在这里教学与研究这两个角色一直是相互补充的。

prior.en: No prior approval is required before submitting the revised manuscript.
prior.zh: 提交修订稿之前不需要任何事先批准。

prior.en: Her prior experience in industry shaped the design of the new curriculum.
prior.zh: 她此前在工业界的经历影响了新课程的设计。

prior.en: Prior studies of this phenomenon produced contradictory results.
prior.zh: 此前对这一现象的研究得出了相互矛盾的结果。

accordingly.en: The funding was cut sharply; accordingly, the project timeline was extended.
accordingly.zh: 经费被大幅削减，因此项目时间表也随之延长。

accordingly.en: Researchers should interpret the results cautiously and accordingly revise their assumptions.
accordingly.zh: 研究人员应谨慎解读结果，并据此修正自己的假设。

accordingly.en: The audience was clearly fascinated, and accordingly the lecture ran well past midnight.
accordingly.zh: 听众显然被吸引住了，因此讲座一直持续到午夜之后很久。

paramount.en: Protecting patient safety remains the paramount concern of every hospital board.
paramount.zh: 保护患者安全始终是每一家医院董事会最首要的关注事项。

paramount.en: Data integrity is paramount, and shortcuts are never acceptable.
paramount.zh: 数据完整性至高无上，捷径永远不可接受。

paramount.en: Of all the criteria, reproducibility is paramount in modern research.
paramount.zh: 在所有标准中，可复现性在现代研究中最为重要。

drastic.en: The government introduced drastic measures to stabilize the housing market.
drastic.zh: 政府采取了严厉措施以稳定住房市场。

drastic.en: A drastic cut in public spending would harm research most.
drastic.zh: 大幅削减公共支出对研究的危害最大。

drastic.en: The company made drastic changes to its organizational structure last spring.
drastic.zh: 公司去年春天对其组织结构进行了重大调整。

dramatic.en: The policy shift produced a dramatic improvement in rural access to healthcare.
dramatic.zh: 政策转变带来了农村医疗可及性的显著改善。

dramatic.en: A dramatic fall in temperatures forced the research team to cancel fieldwork.
dramatic.zh: 气温骤降迫使研究团队取消了野外考察。

dramatic.en: Her dramatic presentation won over the skeptical members of the committee.
dramatic.zh: 她富有感染力的演讲赢得了委员会中持怀疑态度的成员。

exclusively.en: The laboratory conducts research exclusively on marine microorganisms.
exclusively.zh: 该实验室专门研究海洋微生物。

exclusively.en: These materials are sourced exclusively from certified organic farms.
exclusively.zh: 这些材料全部来自经过认证的有机农场。

exclusively.en: The journal publishes exclusively articles that have undergone peer review.
exclusively.zh: 该期刊仅发表经过同行评审的文章。

explicitly.en: The contract explicitly states that all data belong to the university.
explicitly.zh: 合同明确规定，所有数据均归该大学所有。

explicitly.en: She explicitly denied involvement in the disputed data fabrication.
explicitly.zh: 她明确否认参与了有争议的数据捏造行为。

explicitly.en: The guidelines explicitly forbid any use of personal information in advertising.
explicitly.zh: 这些准则明确禁止在任何广告中使用个人信息。

intriguing.en: An intriguing pattern in the data suggests a link between the two variables.
intriguing.zh: 数据中一个耐人寻味的模式暗示两个变量之间存在联系。

intriguing.en: The intriguing manuscript attracted attention from scholars across four continents.
intriguing.zh: 这份耐人寻味的手稿吸引了四大洲学者的关注。

intriguing.en: He proposed an intriguing hypothesis about the origins of the language.
intriguing.zh: 他提出了一个关于该语言起源的引人入胜的假设。

trial.en: The new treatment was tested in a randomized clinical trial.
trial.zh: 这种新疗法在一项随机临床试验中进行了测试。

trial.en: Early trials of the prototype revealed several unexpected hardware failures.
trial.zh: 原型的早期试用暴露出若干意外的硬件故障。

trial.en: The defendant awaits trial before the district court next month.
trial.zh: 被告将于下月在该区法院受审。

prevail.en: Common sense finally prevailed after several hours of heated debate.
prevail.zh: 经过几个小时的激烈辩论，常识终于占了上风。

prevail.en: In the western provinces, traditional crafts still prevail in rural markets.
prevail.zh: 在西部省份，传统手工艺在乡村集市上仍然盛行。

prevail.en: The argument that efficiency should come first prevailed within the committee.
prevail.zh: 效率优先的观点在委员会内部占了上风。

ascribe.en: Historians ascribe the decline of the empire to prolonged internal conflict.
ascribe.zh: 历史学家把帝国的衰落归因于长期的内部冲突。

ascribe.en: The author ascribes her success to persistence and careful planning.
ascribe.zh: 作者认为自己的成功源于坚持和周密的规划。

ascribe.en: Few scholars ascribe the original design to a single architect.
ascribe.zh: 很少有学者把最初的设计归于一位建筑师。

seminal.en: Her seminal paper became the foundation for two decades of research.
seminal.zh: 她的开创性论文成为此后 20 年研究的基础。

seminal.en: The seminar discussed three seminal works in modern linguistics.
seminal.zh: 这场研讨会讨论了现代语言学中的三部开创性著作。

seminal.en: His seminal contribution reshaped how historians interpret the industrial era.
seminal.zh: 他的开创性贡献重塑了历史学家解读工业时代的方式。

subsequent.en: Subsequent studies by other teams confirmed the laboratory's original hypothesis.
subsequent.zh: 其他团队随后的研究证实了该实验室最初的假设。

subsequent.en: The subsequent analysis revealed errors in the collected survey data.
subsequent.zh: 随后的分析揭示了所收集调查数据中的错误。

subsequent.en: Subsequent chapters develop the argument introduced in the opening section.
subsequent.zh: 后续章节展开了开篇部分提出的论点。

extraordinary.en: The region showed extraordinary resilience during the economic downturn.
extraordinary.zh: 该地区在经济衰退期间表现出非凡的韧性。

extraordinary.en: Extraordinary claims require extraordinary evidence in any serious research.
extraordinary.zh: 在任何严肃研究中，非凡的主张都需要非凡的证据。

extraordinary.en: She made the extraordinary discovery hidden in a dusty archive.
extraordinary.zh: 她在积满灰尘的档案中作出了一个非凡的发现。

definitive.en: The court ruling was definitive and ended years of legal dispute.
definitive.zh: 法院的裁决是最终的，结束了长达多年的法律纠纷。

definitive.en: A definitive edition of the poems will be published next spring.
definitive.zh: 这些诗作的权威定本将于明年春天出版。

definitive.en: The absence of any response is not definitive evidence of agreement.
definitive.zh: 没有得到任何回应并不构成赞同的确凿证据。

definite.en: There is no definite answer to the question of causality.
definite.zh: 关于因果关系的问题没有明确的答案。

definite.en: We detected a definite improvement in the quality of translated texts.
definite.zh: 我们发现翻译文本的质量有了明确的提升。

definite.en: A definite deadline makes the project far easier to manage.
definite.zh: 一个明确的截止期限会使项目管理容易得多。

a priori.en: The model was rejected because it relied on a priori assumptions about human behavior.
a priori.zh: 该模型被否决，因为它依赖了对人类行为的先验假设。

a priori.en: A priori reasoning cannot substitute for empirical evidence in clinical decisions.
a priori.zh: 在临床决策中，先验推理无法替代实证证据。

a priori.en: The study was designed a priori rather than in response to unexpected results.
a priori.zh: 该研究是事先设计的，而非因应意外结果而制定。

proceed.en: Work will proceed as planned despite the shortage of laboratory equipment.
proceed.zh: 尽管实验室设备短缺，工作仍将按计划进行。

proceed.en: The committee asked the researchers to proceed with the second phase.
proceed.zh: 委员会要求研究人员继续进行第二阶段的工作。

proceed.en: Having read the report, we proceeded to examine the raw data.
proceed.zh: 读完报告后，我们继续查阅原始数据。

preceding.en: The preceding chapter introduces the theoretical framework used throughout this book.
preceding.zh: 前一章介绍了贯穿本书的理论框架。

preceding.en: Any conclusions must be consistent with the preceding evidence.
preceding.zh: 任何结论都必须与先前的证据保持一致。

preceding.en: The two preceding sentences state the main claim of the article.
preceding.zh: 前面的两句话陈述了文章的主要论点。

considerable.en: The reconstruction required considerable time and a modest budget.
considerable.zh: 这项重建需要相当多的时间和一笔不大的预算。

considerable.en: A considerable number of applications were rejected without explanation.
considerable.zh: 相当多的申请未加解释就被驳回了。

considerable.en: The discovery has had a considerable influence on later research in the field.
considerable.zh: 这一发现对该领域的后续研究产生了相当大的影响。

supplementary.en: Supplementary materials, including raw data, are available on the journal website.
supplementary.zh: 包括原始数据在内的补充材料可在期刊网站上获取。

supplementary.en: The council approved a supplementary budget for rural school construction.
supplementary.zh: 议会批准了一笔用于农村学校建设的补充预算。

supplementary.en: These findings should be read as supplementary to the main analysis.
supplementary.zh: 这些发现应被视为主要分析的补充。

fulfill.en: The scholarship program aims to fulfill the educational needs of rural students.
fulfill.zh: 该奖学金项目旨在满足农村学生的教育需求。

fulfill.en: The laboratory fulfilled every obligation listed in the research contract.
fulfill.zh: 该实验室履行了研究合同中列出的每一项义务。

fulfill.en: She hopes to fulfill her professional ambitions before retiring.
fulfill.zh: 她希望在退休前实现自己的职业抱负。

dictate.en: Corporate interests should not dictate public health policy decisions.
dictate.zh: 企业利益不应左右公共卫生政策的制定。

dictate.en: The schedule was dictated by the arrival of the international review panel.
dictate.zh: 日程安排由国际评审团的到来所决定。

dictate.en: The director dictated that the manuscript be revised within two weeks.
dictate.zh: 主任指示手稿须在两周内完成修订。

moderate.en: The region experienced moderate rainfall throughout the growing season.
moderate.zh: 整个生长季该地区的降雨量适中。

moderate.en: Doctors recommend moderate exercise rather than intense daily training.
moderate.zh: 医生建议进行适度运动，而不是每天高强度训练。

moderate.en: The policy raises existing university fees by a moderate amount.
moderate.zh: 该政策将现有大学学费适度上调。

modest.en: The researchers worked with a modest grant and limited technical support.
modest.zh: 研究人员仅有一笔有限的经费和少量的技术支持。

modest.en: Even a modest improvement in energy efficiency produced significant savings.
modest.zh: 即便能效有小幅提升，也带来了可观的节省。

modest.en: The telescope is available at a modest cost to partner institutions.
modest.zh: 合作机构只需支付不多的费用即可使用这台望远镜。

scheme.en: The government launched a subsidy scheme to support small businesses.
scheme.zh: 政府启动了一项补贴计划以支持小企业。

scheme.en: The color scheme of the new library reflects local architectural traditions.
scheme.zh: 新图书馆的配色方案体现了当地的建筑传统。

scheme.en: A pension scheme has been introduced for all part-time employees.
scheme.zh: 公司已为所有兼职员工引入了一项养老金计划。
